title: Beach Cleanup Rally
desc: Join us to remove coastal litter and restore the shoreline and ocean.
body: We meet at the main entrance at 8:00 AM. Gloves, bags, and a quick safety briefing provided. All ages welcome.

title: Community Recycling Challenge
desc: 28-day recycling challenge with points, prizes, and impact badges.
body: Sign up individually or household-based. Track recycling activity through the challenge portal.

title: Home Composting Workshop
desc: Learn to compost at home, reduce food scraps, and enrich your garden.
location: Irvine Community Center, 1 Community Dr, Irvine, CA 92612
body: Hands-on workshop with bin setup, compost layering, and troubleshooting. Starter kit included.

title: E-Waste Recycling Day
desc: Free drop-off for devices and batteries, plus secure data wipe guidance.
location: City Hall Parking Lot, 4445 Civic Center Dr, Irvine, CA 92602
body: Bring old computers, phones, batteries, and cables. On-site data wipe guidance available.

title: Campus Sustainability Talk
desc: Environmental educators share real circular economy projects in schools.
location: UCI Student Center, 501 Aldrich Hall, Irvine, CA 92697
body: Doors open at 6:00 PM. Free parking after 5 PM.

title: Weekend Tote Bag DIY
desc: Upcycle fabric into a custom tote bag to cut single-use plastic.
location: RecycleBin Creative Studio, 100 Main St, Irvine, CA 92618
body: Bring an old shirt or fabric scrap. Sewing kits and stencils provided.
